title: I’m a huge fan of text/browser RPGs, so I built the kind of one I personally wanted to play. Now I’m trying to find its first players
author: Glad_Cantaloupe_6739
selftext:
I’ve always been really into text-based RPGs, browser games, and games where you slowly build something over time.

So Westbridge basically started from me asking myself:

**“What would actually be fun for me to keep checking every day?”**

I wanted something where I wasn’t just grinding levels or buying stronger gear.

I wanted to start with almost nothing, take jobs, make money, buy materials, build a small business, produce things, sell them, and slowly grow into a bigger part of the city.

That became Westbridge.

It’s a browser-based crime/business RPG set in a rainy harbour city. There are jobs, businesses, production, city orders, markets, equipment, homes, and longer-term progression.

The main loop I’m trying to make fun is:

**Take jobs → earn resources → buy materials → produce goods → sell them → reinvest.**

And to be completely transparent, right now I’m basically the only person seriously playing it 😭

That’s actually why I’m posting now.

I’ve spent enough time building it alone, and I’d love to start finding people who genuinely enjoy these kinds of games and slowly build a small community around Westbridge.

I’m not expecting some giant player economy overnight. The game has city buyers and orders so you can progress solo while the community is small.

I mainly want people who enjoy this genre to try it and tell me what they actually find fun, boring, confusing, or missing.

You can play it directly in the browser here:

[https://play-westbridge.vercel.app](https://play-westbridge.vercel.app/)

I’m also thinking about starting a small Discord where early players can give feedback, suggest features, report bugs, and follow development.

Would that be something you’d join for a game this early, or would you rather just have updates posted here?
